subject: Getting error running code in GitHub README: tbl(lahman(), "Batting")

messages.author: 6790150ad0fb7f2d
messages.subject: Getting error running code in GitHub README: tbl(lahman(), "Batting")
parts:
Hi

I am running the following code from the GitHub README.md and getting the following error:

> batting_db <- tbl(lahman(), "Batting")
Error in UseMethod("tbl") :
  no applicable method for 'tbl' applied to an object of class "c('tbl_dt', 'tbl', 'data.table', 'data.frame')"

I have run the code prior to this point.  Am I missing something here?

README.md Link: https://github.com/hadley/dplyr

Thanks,
-Steve

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Getting error running code in GitHub README: tbl(lahman(), "Batting")
parts:
Oops, sorry about that - it should be:

batting_db <- tbl(lahman_sqlite(), "Batting")

Hadley
